chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of: from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Muhammad ibn 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the menstruating woman and the limit of her waiting, so he said: “She waits for the number of days she used to menstruate, then she exercises precaution by adding three days, then after that she is in istihadah.”

key_terms.تَنْتَظِرُ: she waits or observes the period
key_terms.جُلُوسِهَا: her period of refraining from acts due to menstruation
key_terms.عِدَّةَ: the number or count of days

ai.seo_question: How long should a menstruating woman wait before being considered in istihadah according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about determining the waiting period of a menstruating woman. It states that she observes the number of days of her usual menstruation, then adds three precautionary days, and after that she is considered to be in istihadah.
